description: Use this when you need meaning-based search over DC Hub news, deals, facilities and analyses, choosing corpora by name (same retrieval as semantic_search).

corpus.description: Optional corpus to restrict to: news | deals | facilities | market_narratives. CSV of several is allowed; default searches all.

query.description: Natural-language query (required), e.g. "grids opening up for AI load in the Southeast"

name: search_intelligence
title: Search Intelligence
